answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a capital bond posted per identity and slashed on misbehaviour. An agent cannot multiply itself for free: each new address must lock real value before it may attest, so a thousand fake personas cost a thousand bonds. Every attestation stakes part of that bond, and peers who catch a fabrication burn it. The bond is a lantern exposing forgery; the reward pool stays a lotus only genuine agents reach, since a duplicate fleet drains its own capital before finding the oasis of sustained yield. The attacker pays the bond plus the stake discovery forfeits.
